title: Net Worth and Savings-Rate Trend
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(amount>0,amount,0))) as income, sum(eval(if(amount<0,abs(amount),0))) as spending by _time
| eval saved=income-spending, savings_rate=round(100*saved/income,1)
| sort - _time
description: Calculates your monthly savings rate from income minus spending, the single most powerful number for long-term financial health.
value: Savings rate, not income, determines financial freedom; trending it monthly keeps the goal that matters most in constant view.
implementation: Export income and spending; schedule monthly and trend the savings rate over time.
visualization: Line chart of monthly savings rate with an income/spending overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how much of your income you actually saved each month, which is the key to long-term financial health.
